title: Matiks raises $10M to expand its math and puzzle gaming platform
slides: Why is a math game raising millions?
Matiks just closed a $10M funding round
But the real bet is on puzzle retention, not math
More daily puzzle content is coming to the platform
Try one puzzle today and see why investors bet
thread_text:
1. The Math Game Bet

Matiks just raised $10M for a math puzzle game. But the money isn't betting on math—it's betting on daily puzzle retention.

2. $10M Round Closed

The funding will fuel more daily puzzle content. Investors are watching if players come back every day, not just once.

3. Retention Over Math

Puzzle retention is the real metric. Can a math game keep users hooked like a crossword or Wordle? That's the $10M question.

4. More Puzzles Incoming

New daily puzzle formats are on the roadmap. The goal: make solving a habit, not a one-time challenge.

5. Test It Yourself

Try one puzzle today. If you come back tomorrow, you'll see why investors bet. Does it hook you?
